You see smoke on the horizon. The Bloodied — 3 people, 98 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 15 plants — 13 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.
